quest.title: Bottleneck Breaking
quest.description: You tell Sayu that she needs enough nutrition to grow tall. She follows you enthusiastically to Inazuma City...

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarders' camp

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Anna was right, there's the Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: All that food we just ate is weighing me down a bit, but I think we can still handle them.

talks.objective: Chase the Treasure Hoarders away for Kiminami Anna
The battle is over, talk to Sayu
Go to a high spot to relax with Sayu

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Thanks again for offering your help. Please do be careful out there.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: She did eat quite a lot, will she be okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: You should keep an eye on her, just in case.
